purpose: Deterministically scored smoke tasks. Not the required held-out perplexity corpus.

tasks.prompt: Trace this Omega function: fn choose a int b int to int; if gt a b; ret sub a b; else; ret add a b; end; end. Semicolons denote line breaks. What integer does choose 7 3 return? Reply with only the integer.
An integer program sets sum=0 and adds each integer i for i=0,1,2,3,4. What is the final sum? Reply with only the integer.
The blue crate arrived before the green crate. The red crate arrived after the green crate. Which crate arrived first? Reply with only its color in lowercase.
Mira checked three valves. Valve A was open, valve B was closed, and valve C was open. Which valve was closed? Reply with only its uppercase letter.
